name: Titanbone Ribs
introDiscord:
The next skeleton makes the ribs behind you look small.

Titanbone arches rise like the frame of a ruined cathedral while Crabs
have built homes, pathways, and apparently an entire society across the
bones.
introTwitch:
The next skeleton makes the ribs behind you look small.

Titanbone arches rise like the frame of a ruined cathedral while Crabs
have built homes, pathways, and apparently an entire society across the
bones.

titanbone-ribs-approach.prompt:
Three paths wind between ribs broad enough to support coral gardens.
Titanbone Crabs patrol every desirable ledge.

left.message:
A Crab has piled shells around an old cache lodged beneath the bone.

The arrangement is surprisingly tasteful.

You remove the Star Candies.

The Crab architecture critic has not been consulted.

right.message:
A mineral spring rises where coral has grown through a cracked rib.

Shizuki's note reads:

'Camped ON rib tonight.

Not beside rib.

ON.

This thing is wider than my campsite.

I am handling this information normally.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative spring untouched.

Handling the scale of the skeleton normally remains optional.

forward.message:
A Titanbone Crab emerges from a hollow inside the rib itself.

The Crab lives in the bone.

You are trying not to think about how many Crab apartments fit in there.

titanbone-ribs-depths.prompt:
Deeper inside the skeleton, three routes cross vertebrae and immense
scales buried among the ribs.

left.message:
A Titanbone Crab raises both claws from atop a vertebra.

It has claimed the high ground.

Unfortunately, the high ground is a dead Leviathan.

right.message:
One Berry sits inside a tiny shell bowl beside Shizuki's sketch:

'Potential home?

Pros:
Huge.
Strong roof.
Amazing view.

Cons:
IS SKELETON.'

forward.message:
A navigator's chest is wedged inside a gap between two vertebrae.

The gap is large enough to contain the chest, you, and several deeply
uncomfortable anatomical observations.

titanbone-ribs-threshold.prompt:
The Colossal Ribcage surrounds three final routes, its curved bones
meeting far overhead.

left.message:
A wrecked strongbox rests beneath a rib engraved by countless travelers.

Shizuki added one tiny mark:

'Shizuki + Glimmer were here.

Did not touch giant skeleton irresponsibly.

Mostly.'

right.message:
A Titanbone Crab drops from the rib above.

There was apparently an upstairs Crab.

forward.message:
A calm pocket forms where two ribs overlap.

Shizuki's bottle says:

'Excellent resting spot.

Please ignore fact we are technically sitting inside chest cavity.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative untouched.

The phrase 'chest cavity' has already done enough.

boss-antechamber.name: Colossal Ribcage
boss-antechamber.prompt: The ribs ahead curve inward around an enormous hollow.

bossPromptDiscord:
The ribs ahead curve inward around an enormous hollow.

Hundreds of smaller Titanbone Crabs retreat into cracks in the skeleton.

One set of claws remains outside.

They are considerably larger than you.

Use /yes to enter the Colossal Ribcage or /no to respect the apparent
landlord.
bossPromptTwitch:
The ribs ahead curve inward around an enormous hollow.

Hundreds of smaller Titanbone Crabs retreat into cracks in the skeleton.

One set of claws remains outside.

They are considerably larger than you.

Use !yes to enter the Colossal Ribcage or !no to respect the apparent
landlord.
bossRetreatText:
You back away.

Several tiny Crabs immediately return to their bone apartments.

boss.revealText:
An enormous Crab tears free from beneath the ancient ribs.

Ossuary Clawking reveals itself!

completionText:
The Ossuary Clawking retreats deep into the skeleton.

The smaller Crabs cautiously emerge.

One immediately begins repairing the shell decoration you disturbed.

Sorry.
